qualifier: nodal and His-Purkinje development with gap junction electrical coupling
name: Cardiac conduction system development and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover development of the SA node, AV node and His-Purkinje system plus gap-junction electrical coupling in conduction, whereas confusables centre on action-potential depolarization or early cardiomyocyte fate.

qualifier: L1-family, DSCAM, sidekick and netrin cues
name: Neurite guidance via L1, DSCAM and netrin
rationale: All members concern axon or dendrite guidance and self-avoidance through L1/CHL1, DSCAM, SDK and netrin signalling, distinguishing it from semaphorin-, ephrin- and adhesion-centred guidance themes.

name: Muscle ion transport inhibition, including SERCA calcium uptake
rationale: Members are mostly negative regulation of calcium and potassium transport, action potentials and SERCA-mediated SR calcium import in striated muscle, unlike confusables about calcium release, heart rate or cardiac repolarization channels.

qualifier: lysosomal amino-sugar catabolism and enzyme secretion
name: Glycosphingolipid turnover with lysosomal amino-sugar catabolism
rationale: Members cover ganglioside and glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal hexosaminidase/sialidase degradation plus glucosamine-compound catabolism, separating it from sialic acid, N-glycan, GPI and sphingomyelin themes.

name: Reelin signaling and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members combine Reelin signalling with dendrite development, spine maintenance and postsynaptic membrane organization, whereas confusables concern synaptic plasticity, amyloid-beta responses or microglia.

qualifier: matrix and membrane protein import, fission, pexophagy
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members concern targeting and import of peroxisomal proteins, peroxisome fission and autophagy of peroxisomes, while confusables are peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism with eicosanoid receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover lipoxygenase-derived leukotriene, lipoxin and HETE synthesis, transport and catabolism plus leukotriene and prostanoid receptors, lacking the resolvin, protectin and CYP epoxygenase content of confusables.

qualifier: Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell branches from zymosterol
name: Late cholesterol biosynthesis via Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell branches
rationale: All members are the post-lanosterol sterol steps through zymosterol, desmosterol and lathosterol, distinct from mevalonate/isoprenoid, bile acid and fatty acid confusables.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and renal sodium-potassium handling
rationale: Members centre on SLC12 cotransporters (NKCC2, NCC, KCC3 disorders) with renal sodium transport and potassium uptake, unlike confusables on osmotic/water balance, magnesium transport or sodium-proton exchange.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of RIG-I/MDA5
name: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling and its regulation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic dsRNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5, its positive and negative regulation and downstream IRF3 and NF-kB activation, while confusables emphasize interferon responses, cGAS/STING and TLR routes.

name: CSF1 and GM-CSF signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members combine M-CSF and GM-CSF receptor signalling with macrophage proliferation and monocyte, macrophage and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation, distinct from granulocyte and osteoclast confusables.

qualifier: ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid and ganglioside biosynthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism including GM2 gangliosidoses and sialidosis, unlike sphingomyelin/ceramide and glycosylation confusables.

name: Granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation
rationale: Members concern neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation driven by G-CSF and GM-CSF, whereas confusables add monocyte/M-CSF and progenitor programs and lack eosinophil and mast cell members.

name: Fas and TRAIL death receptor caspase-8 apoptotic signaling
rationale: Members cover FasL and TRAIL signalling, procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP inhibition and BID activation, separating it from necroptosis and intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: radial and tangential migration, cortical lamination
name: Neuronal migration and cortical lamination in brain development
rationale: Members concern radial and tangential neuronal migration, cortical layering and regionalization and neuron specification in forebrain structures, unlike commissure morphogenesis and spinal cord patterning confusables.

name: p53 turnover and G2/M mitotic progression control
rationale: Members link p53 degradation and phosphorylation (COP1, GTSE1) with MASTL and Cdc25A-dependent G2/M progression, distinct from DNA-damage checkpoint and G1/S confusables.

name: Guanylyl cyclase cGMP signaling in natriuresis and diuresis
rationale: Members combine cGMP synthesis, receptor guanylyl cyclase regulation and cyclic nucleotide responses with renal sodium excretion and urine volume, unlike renin-angiotensin and vascular-tone confusables.

name: Growth hormone and IGF signaling in growth and lifespan
rationale: Members cover GH receptor JAK-STAT signalling, GH secretion, IGF responses and control of growth rate and lifespan, whereas confusables involve leptin, prolactin, thyroid and somatostatin hormones.

name: Stromal fibroblast secretory program with TGF-beta1 production control
rationale: Members are fibroblast/perivascular stromal modules with fibroblast proliferation, KRAS/FOSL targets and regulation of TGF-beta1 production, distinct from mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ, endothelial and core ECM confusables.

name: Nuclear exosome RNA 3' processing and surveillance decay
rationale: Members concern 3'-to-5' exonucleolytic trimming and decay of snRNA, snoRNA, rRNA, CUTs and tRNA in the nucleus, unlike rRNA endonucleolytic processing, splicing, NMD and snoRNP confusables.

core: Stress-responsive transcriptional control of metabolism and survival
name: FOXO and NRF2 stress transcription controlling metabolism and survival
rationale: Members centre on FOXO and NFE2L2 transcriptional programs with AKT, p53 and mTORC1 control of NADPH, glycolytic and survival genes, whereas confusables are hypoxia/glycolysis or ER unfolded protein response themes.

qualifier: retrograde transport and plasma membrane recycling
name: Endosome-Golgi retrograde and plasma membrane recycling traffic
rationale: Members cover endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport, Golgi retention and receptor recycling to the plasma membrane, distinct from Golgi organization, COPI vesicle and lysosome biogenesis confusables.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
rationale: Members pair calcineurin-NFAT regulation with cardiac muscle adaptation, cell size, sarcomere organization and cardiomyocyte growth, whereas confusables cover skeletal muscle, stress hypertrophy without calcineurin, or contractility.

qualifier: alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport
name: Alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport
rationale: Members split between pulmonary surfactant metabolism and its deficiency disorders and erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange with Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport, sharing respiratory gas exchange and lacking the heme/iron and lung development content of confusables.

name: De novo phospholipid synthesis including cardiolipin and its remodeling
rationale: Members are CDP-DAG and CDP-choline routes to PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin plus cardiolipin/PG acyl remodeling, unlike PA/TAG, general Lands-cycle remodeling and lipid transfer confusables.
